# Vendored: text-to-lottie

Source: https://github.com/diffusionstudio/lottie (directory `skills/text-to-lottie`)
Commit: 3c72912fad543897f90045ed4d355813837927fc (2026-07-25)
License: MIT (see `text-to-lottie/LICENSE`)

The files under `text-to-lottie/` are copied unchanged so they can be updated
from upstream. Do not edit them; put our additions in `skills/lottie-animation/`.
`text-to-lottie/SKILL.md` is not a registry entry: the registry only reads
`skills/*/SKILL.md`, and this copy's description would otherwise match tasks
about editing, data, charts, and debugging that have nothing to do with motion.

To update: fetch the upstream directory at a newer commit, replace
`text-to-lottie/` wholesale, update the commit above, and re-run
`python -m pytest tests/test_lottie_animation.py`.
